assertion.statement: An earlier rename of the extra resources field in the RunFunction protobuf API was rolled back.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The note only says a field name change was rolled back. It does not give the old or new field names, or say whether the rename ever shipped in a release before 2.0.0. So we can't tell if anything changed compared with the previous release.; applicability: No field name, function SDK version or setting is given that could show whether an environment is exposed.; consequence: The evidence does not say what happens to functions or compositions.
